E2.4.07: A wide fictional composition with a simple beautifully made ivory wooden table on the left, one blue bowl and red apple; on the right a shop window filled with many varied blue and red abstract household products, no brands or labels. Both sides dignified, not dirty or villainous; a quiet question about priorities, no moral ranking.
Mesa sencilla bien hecha junto a un escaparate con diversos objetos azules y rojos sin marcas.

A blue paper tree growing in ivory soil, with several red seeds saved in a small open bowl beside the trunk and a few freshly planted seeds in visible soil cross section. Conceptual cultivation, no monetary returns, no numbers. Landscape.
Árbol azul de papel junto a un cuenco con semillas rojas y tierra en capas.

A sculptural ivory balance beam with two equal stable pans: one blue shopping bag with a single red object on left, one red toolbox with plain blue tools on right. Level balanced, no cash, no words. Conceptual choices rather than moral judgement. Landscape.
Balanza equilibrada con una bolsa de compras y una caja de herramientas, sin cifras.
E2.4.08: Five fictional diverse adults of different ages comfortably seated around a small safe stylized ivory-and-red campfire in an open courtyard, blue and red clothing, warm faces, equal respectful positions, plenty of air and no lettering. Landscape.
Cinco adultos ficticios de distintas edades sentados alrededor de una pequeña hoguera en un patio abierto.

Two independent blue paper trees with their own roots in ivory soil, one red graft branch gently connecting to a blue trunk with a neat ivory graft wrap. Both trees remain whole, growth as relational metaphor with no medical or family hierarchy implication. Landscape.
Dos árboles de papel con raíces propias y una rama roja injertada que los conecta.

An older fictional adult mentor offering a simple round blue compass to a younger fictional adult, both standing side by side and facing an open path; compass face has only a red needle, absolutely no letters, digits or labels. Younger adult chooses freely, no authority posture. Landscape.
Una persona adulta ofrece una brújula sin letras a otra junto a un camino abierto.
E2.4.09: Wide overhead view of a long ivory dining table with simple blue plates, red serving dish and multiple adult hands naturally passing a bowl of vegetables, no faces or specific country, modest welcoming meal, no text.
Manos adultas se pasan una fuente de verduras sobre una mesa larga con platos azules.

Conceptual ivory paper calendar board with seven columns and four rows of small blank squares, exactly one red circular ring in the last column of each row, no letters, numbers, dates or writing anywhere. A recurring meeting symbol, not a real dated calendar. Landscape.
Calendario conceptual sin fechas con cuatro marcas circulares rojas en una misma columna.

A blank open blue-bound notebook with a plain red pencil beside a steaming ivory bowl of soup on a warm table, abstract red and blue background, no accounts, digits, writing or logos. Peaceful domestic editorial landscape.
Libreta abierta sin texto y lápiz rojo junto a un cuenco de sopa.
